root_cause.trajectory_summary: The agent used a pre-built skill pipeline to process a 600s teaching video. Turn 1 verified input (600.00s). Turn 2 discovered skill scripts. Turns 3-4 extracted audio and computed per-second RMS energies. Turn 5 detected the opening silence (0-221s, 3.68 min). Turn 6 detected 11 pauses (≥2s) between 228s-599s totaling 28s. Turn 7 combined into 12 segments (249s total). Turn 8 processed the video to produce compressed_video.mp4 (351.00s, 41.5% compression). Turn 9 generated compression_report.json in the required schema. Turns 10-11 verified files exist and ffprobe confirms compressed duration is 351.00s. Turn 12 signalled completion.

what_worked.item: Turn 1: correctly probed input video duration (600.004626s) before processing.
Turn 3: audio extracted successfully to work/audio.wav (18.31 MB, 16kHz).
Turn 5: opening silence detected as 0-221s, matching the task's "unnecessary opening" requirement.
Turn 6: 11 pauses detected all with duration ≥ 2s, matching the "long pauses > 2 sec" requirement.
Turn 8: video processor produced compressed_video.mp4 with reported output 351.00s and 41.5% compression.

Turn 9: compression_report.json produced with required keys (original_duration_seconds, compressed_duration_seconds, removed_duration_seconds, compression_percentage, segments_removed with start/end/duration).
Turn 11: ffprobe independently confirms compressed_video.mp4 duration = 351.003991s, matching the report; math 351 + 249 = 600 is consistent.

root_cause.outcome_assessment: Both deliverables exist with valid schema, ffprobe-verified duration matches the report, math is consistent, and the removed segments cover the opening plus long pauses as required.
